nodes.description: Oasis market interface instance stored in contract state
Public address of the external Oasis market
Public DAI token address used as oracle pair asset
Public WETH token address used as oracle pair asset
Mapping of user address to locked ETH collateral
Mapping of user address to minted token balance
Constructor that stores market address and instantiates Oasis market
Payable deposit that credits locked[msg.sender] with msg.value
Mints tokens based on oracle price, crediting tokenBalance[msg.sender]
Burns caller tokens from tokenBalance
View function returning the ETH value of a user token balance
Withdraws locked ETH collateral via external transfer to msg.sender
Queries the Oasis market order book to derive a WETH/DAI price
Untrusted caller address used for authorization and mapping indexing
External ETH transfer msg.sender.transfer(payout) executed in withdraw
External calls market.getBestOffer and market.getOffer trusting returned data as price
Multiplication amount*1e18 performed before division, overflow-prone arithmetic
Constructor parameter addr used to set marketAddress
Mint parameter amount used in token calculation
Burn parameter amount checked and subtracted from tokenBalance
tokenValue parameter user whose balance is read
Local currentPrice obtained from getPrice inside mint
Local tokens amount computed in mint and added to tokenBalance
Local payout holding locked[msg.sender] before reset and transfer

edges.reason: msg.sender is used to index and credit the locked mapping in deposit
msg.sender indexes the tokenBalance mapping in mint and burn
deposit authorization and accounting depend entirely on the caller msg.sender
withdraw authorization and payout depend on the untrusted caller msg.sender
deposit writes msg.value into locked[msg.sender]
mint updates tokenBalance[msg.sender] with computed tokens
mint executes the multiplication amount*1e18 before dividing
attacker-controlled amount parameter flows into the overflow-prone multiplication
result of amount*1e18 division is stored in the tokens local variable
currentPrice divides the scaled amount when computing tokens
getPrice return value is assigned to currentPrice in mint
mint invokes getPrice to obtain the oracle-derived price
burn subtracts from tokenBalance[msg.sender]
burn amount parameter is checked and subtracted from the caller balance
withdraw executes an external ETH transfer to the caller
local payout value is sent to msg.sender in the external call
external call interacts with the locked mapping state that was reset just before
getPrice trusts an external untrusted market contract for price discovery
oracle call market.getBestOffer returns the offer id
offer id from the oracle is passed into market.getOffer to fetch buyAmt
oracle call market.getOffer returns buyAmt used for pricing
payAmt divides the scaled buyAmt into the rate
buyAmt is multiplied by 1e18 to compute the rate
local rate is returned by getPrice
tokenValue calls getPrice to value the user balance
tokenValue reads tokenBalance indexed by the user parameter
constructor addr parameter is assigned to marketAddress
constructor stores marketAddress state variable
constructor casts the stored address into the Oasis market instance
dai address is used as the buy asset in market.getBestOffer
weth address is used as the sell asset in market.getBestOffer
computed tokens local is added into tokenBalance[msg.sender]

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter addr is only used to initialize marketAddress and market within the constructor
Mint parameter amount is consumed only by the mint token calculation
Burn parameter amount is consumed only by the burn balance reduction
tokenValue parameter user is only used to read tokenBalance inside that view function
Local currentPrice is a temporary holding the getPrice result inside mint
Local tokens is the intermediate mint result credited to tokenBalance
Local payout is the exact value forwarded by the external transfer in withdraw
Local id holds the oracle offer id used within getPrice
Local payAmt is an oracle-returned value used for the rate computation
Local buyAmt is an oracle-returned value used for the rate computation
Local rate is the final derived price returned by getPrice
